{{Infobox auto}}

'''Apple cinnamon oatmeal''' is a breakfast bowl that heals {{Value|Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Speed}} for {{Value|Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal|duration|effect=Speed}} and {{EffectLink|Regeneration}} for {{Value|Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal|duration|effect=Regeneration}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/oatmeal.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A honey bottle, a [[Milk Bottle|milk bottle]], estus ash, a raw [[apple]], 2 [[Wheat Grain|wheat grain]] and a [[bowl]]. Picking up a bowl unlocks the recipe. The honey bottle's glass bottle is left in the crafting grid, as in vanilla. The milk bottle's glass bottle is meant to be given back too, but in 1.12.2-beta the advancement that returns it still names the recipe by an old ID, so it is used up.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/glass_bottle_from_crafting.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes {{Value|Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal|heals}} and gives Speed {{Value|Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal|level|effect=Speed}} (+20%) for {{Value|Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal|duration|effect=Speed|format=clock}} and Regeneration {{Value|Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal|level|effect=Regeneration}} for {{Value|Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal|duration|effect=Regeneration|format=clock}}. The bowl is given back.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].
